title: Forge LLM: Document-Based Model Fine-Tuning Tool
description: I built this to make fine-tuning language models less of a headache. Upload PDFs, and it automatically extracts the text and generates training data from your documents. Then you can fine-tune models using LoRA - a technique that lets you customize models without needing a supercomputer. The whole workflow from document to trained model is in one place, so you don't have to juggle multiple tools.

title: Should I Go Outside? Weather-Based Activity Advisor
description: Ever checked the weather and still wondered if it's actually nice enough to go outside? I built this to solve that exact problem. It pulls real-time weather and air quality data, checks your calendar, and tells you if it's a good day for outdoor activities. I even threw in an AI that suggests what you should do based on the conditions - all running locally with Ollama.

title: Gmail Automation Tool: AI-Powered Email Management
description: I got tired of drowning in emails, so I built this to help me out. It connects to Gmail, reads through your messages, and uses a local AI to summarize them and even draft replies. No cloud services needed - everything runs on your machine with Ollama, so your emails stay private.

title: Offline Wiki: RAG-Powered Knowledge Base
description: I wanted to have Wikipedia access without internet, so I built this offline search system. You can ask it questions about European destinations in natural language, and it'll search through thousands of Wikipedia and Wikivoyage articles to give you answers. Perfect for when you're traveling and don't have data or just want a fast, private way to look things up.

title: Jonas: Your Personal Austrian German Tutor
description: Meet Jonas, a friendly AI chatbot designed to be your personal guide to Austrian German and culture. I built Jonas to be more than just a language app; he's a conversational partner who makes learning feel like chatting with a local. Using a fine-tuned language model and a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system I built with FAISS, Jonas can answer your questions about Austria, explain grammar in a simple way, and teach you everything from classic phrases to modern slang.

title: Austrian News Summarizer: AI-Powered News Translation
description: Living in Austria but not fluent in German yet? I made this to keep up with local news from ORF.at. It grabs the latest articles, translates them from German to English, and gives you clean summaries - all using a local AI so you're not sending your data anywhere. Now I can actually understand what's happening in my city.

title: Song popularity predictor
description: I got curious about what makes songs popular, so I built a model to predict it. Used linear regression on synthetic song data to see which features matter most. Simple project, but it was fun to see what the numbers said about hit songs.

title: Whatsapp Bot
description: A simple WhatsApp bot I threw together using Twilio's API. Nothing fancy, just wanted to experiment with automating messages and see how the Twilio integration works.

title: SIMCLR implementation on medical dataset
description: Implemented self-supervised learning on medical images using SimCLR. It's a cool technique that lets the model learn useful features without needing labeled data - pretty helpful when you're working with medical datasets where labels are expensive to get.

title: Austrian Food Price Analysis & Email Automation
description: I dug into Austrian food prices to see how much producers vs consumers are getting squeezed. Analyzed the gap between what producers charge and what we pay at the store using official price data. The numbers tell an interesting story about who's really benefiting.

title: Sales Report Automation
description: Turned a manual, repetitive task into a one-click operation. Takes raw sales data, generates charts and insights automatically, and emails out the reports. Saved me (and probably others) hours of copy-pasting into Excel every week.

title: Malaria Cell Image Classification (CNN)
description: Built a neural network to detect malaria-infected cells from microscope images. The model learns to spot the differences between healthy and infected cells - the kind of task that could help speed up diagnosis in places where trained specialists are scarce.

title: Klinikum Report Editor
description: A web app I built for managing mental health report data. You can customize fields, visualize trends with interactive graphs, and export everything to PDF. Made it flexible enough to adapt to different reporting needs while keeping the interface clean and straightforward.
